hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that charges fees in the payment token on each swap: a fixed 1% base fee plus a creator-configured tax up to 10%, split between a protocol recipient and a creator recipient via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapReturnDelta. Liquidity additions are restricted to an approved position manager. Pool graduation is tracked by checking whether the current tick has crossed a configured graduation tick after each swap.
